title: Prescription Adherence Log Doses Taken Leaderboard
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prescription:adherence doses_taken=*
| stats sum(doses_taken) as total_value, avg(doses_taken) as avg_value by drug_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks drug values by total and average doses taken across prescription adherence log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `doses_taken` values for each prescription adherence log event and review total and average doses taken by drug.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total doses taken.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which drug shows the biggest doses taken numbers in your prescription adherence log data.
